Q1.rationale: The agreement contains no reverse engineering prohibition; the only related text is the use restriction in segment 15.
Q1.label: NotMentioned

Q2.rationale: Segment 32 requires return or destruction only promptly upon written request, not upon termination of the Agreement, so the termination trigger is absent.
Q2.label: NotMentioned

Q3.rationale: The NDA does not state that no right or license to Confidential Information is granted; segment 37 concerns only the Transaction.
Q3.label: NotMentioned

Q4.rationale: Segment 14 bars disclosing the fact that discussions are taking place concerning the Transaction or any terms of it, which covers the fact of the agreement's negotiation.
Q4.label: Entailment

Q5.rationale: Segment 4 covers business prospects, financial condition, operations and assets as well as technology, which is incompatible with a technical-only scope.
Q5.label: Contradiction

Q6.rationale: The NDA contains no requirement that Evaluation Material be expressly identified or marked by the Disclosing Party.
Q6.label: NotMentioned

Q7.rationale: Segment 35 states that sections 4, 5 and 7 through 12 survive any termination of the Agreement.
Q7.label: Entailment

Q8.rationale: Segment 12(d) excludes independently developed information, and segment 27 permits developing similar or related technology.
Q8.label: Entailment

Q9.rationale: Segment 33 lets the receiving party and its Representatives retain one copy of the Evaluation Material, and segment 34 continues confidentiality after return or destruction.
Q9.label: Entailment

Q10.rationale: The NDA does not expressly mention verbally conveyed information as Confidential Information; Evaluation Material is described without reference to oral form.
Q10.label: NotMentioned

Q11.rationale: The NDA contains no non-solicitation covenant regarding the other party's representatives.
Q11.label: NotMentioned

Q12.rationale: Segment 5 defines Representatives to include agents and advisors, and segment 14 permits disclosure to Representatives who agree or are bound not to disclose.
Q12.label: Entailment

Q13.rationale: Segment 33 permits retaining one copy of the Evaluation Material to show compliance or meet legal requirements, which is a carve-out permitting a copy.
Q13.label: Entailment

Q14.rationale: Segment 29 requires the party facing a legal or other required disclosure to give the other party prior written notice to the extent reasonable and practicable.
Q14.label: Entailment

Q15.rationale: Segment 10 excludes information available from a source other than the disclosing party, which permits acquiring similar information from a third party.
Q15.label: Entailment

Q16.rationale: Segments 5 and 14 permit disclosure to the party's Representatives, which include employees, provided they are bound not to disclose.
Q16.label: Entailment

Q17.rationale: Segment 15 limits use of Evaluation Material to evaluating, negotiating, facilitating or pursuing a Transaction.
Q17.label: Entailment
